data.long_meaning: Ram means 'God' and Nivas means 'Abode'. Therefore, Ramnivas means 'God's Abode'. The name Ramnivas carries the meaning “God's Abode” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Ramnivas usually hope their child will grow to embody god's abode and live with faith, good character and purpose.
